resources.string: Quick cast opens your phone\'s built-in cast settings (Miracast / Google Cast). It does not use this app\'s connection.
Ready. Tap Start, then choose what to share.
The shared app is not visible. Bring it to the front to resume.
Preview of what will be sent. If this screen is being shared you will see it repeat; that is expected.
Capture ended. You or the system stopped sharing (for example from the status-bar cast chip, or because the screen was locked).
Android refused to start screen capture. Tap Start again and approve the permission dialog.
Android did not allow the capture service to start. Make sure the app is open and try again.
Screen capture failed to start. Please try again.
Screen capture permission was declined. Nothing is being shared.
This device has no system cast settings screen.
Could not start the capture service. Please try again.
Capture still works, but you won\'t see the Stop button in the notification shade. Use Stop in this app or the status-bar cast chip, or turn notifications on.
Shown while your screen is being captured.
